milestone.title: test coverage gap closure — autopilot_detach, breaking_release apply, archive/purge/metrics, gates G6/G14, error-path negatives

intent.outcome: Each handler and validate gate that ships in `crates/mp` has at least one direct integration test covering both happy and error paths, so a regression in any of them surfaces in CI instead of dogfood.

problem.description:
Handler modules with thin or zero direct coverage (verified 2026-09-27):
- crates/mp/src/commands/autopilot_detach.rs: no functional test; only help-text checks (autopilot_cli_tree.rs, watch_cli.rs) mention --detach.
- crates/mp/src/commands/breaking_release.rs apply arm: the .mp/breaking_release.json write and the bail! branch are uncovered; only preflight is exercised (suites/ws3_ws4_batch.rs).
- crates/mp/src/commands/metrics.rs (`mp plan metrics show|set`): only a --help / taxonomy smoke.
- crates/mp/src/commands/archive.rs: the milestone arm is well covered (suites/milestone_archive.rs: restore, purge, list-archived); the TrackItem arm (`mp track archive track-item`) is only exercised on its failure-rollback path (mutation_transactions.rs:568).
- Gates G6 and G14 are covered in suites/gate_matrix.rs, but g6_fires_when_ac_not_passed_at_verified asserts `stderr.contains("G6") || !status.success()` — it passes on ANY failure, so a regression that fails for another reason stays green.
- ?-propagated error paths in commands/config.rs, git.rs, archive.rs, digest.rs have no negative integration tests (suites/digest.rs:119 `--since not-a-duration` is the only template).

in_scope: New top-level test binary crates/mp/tests/autopilot_drive_detach.rs: detached child survives parent exit (setsid); run state file written to .mp/autopilot-run.state.json; SIGTERM to the recorded pid triggers killpg; preflight refusal returns exit 2. Uses common/fake_herdr.rs.

New top-level test binary crates/mp/tests/breaking_release_apply.rs: apply after clean preflight writes .mp/breaking_release.json; apply after blocked preflight exits non-zero with the bail message unchanged.
New crates/mp/tests/suites/metrics.rs, included from crates/mp/tests/suite_misc.rs via #[path]: `mp plan metrics set` then `show` round-trips; unknown metric field errors.
Extend crates/mp/tests/suites/track_lifecycle.rs (or add a module to suite_track.rs) with a positive `mp track archive track-item` test.
Tighten suites/gate_matrix.rs G6 so it requires the G6 code specifically (not `|| !success`), and add a G6 negative case (all ACs passed → no G6).

At least three negative integration tests (new top-level binaries config_cmd_negative.rs, archive_negative.rs, digest_negative.rs) driving existing bail!/with_context branches to non-zero exits with the expected message.
CHANGELOG entry grouping the coverage gains; no behavior change.
out_of_scope: Refactoring the implementations under test — tests only. If a test exposes a real bug, file a backlog item instead of fixing it here.
Re-doing tests that already pass (milestone archive/restore/purge, G14).

acceptance_criteria.description: autopilot_detach.rs has at least three behavioral tests that exercise the setsid detach, state-file write, and shutdown paths.
breaking_release::apply has direct coverage of the write-marker and the bailout error branches.
mp plan metrics has a dedicated suite covering set→show round-trip and an unknown-field error.
The TrackItem arm of archive.rs has a positive integration test (a track item is archived and no longer listed as active).
gate_matrix G6 test requires the G6 code specifically (no '|| !success' escape) and has a negative case; G14 tests keep passing.
acceptance_criteria.verification: ! rg -q 'contains\("G6"\) \|\| !out.status.success' crates/mp/tests/suites/gate_matrix.rs && cargo nextest run -p mp --test suite_validate --no-fail-fast -E 'test(/^gate_matrix::g(6|14)_/)'

acceptance_criteria.description: At least three negative integration tests exist that drive existing `?`-propagated error paths in config.rs / git.rs / archive.rs / digest.rs to non-zero exits, and CI runs them.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p mp --test config_cmd_negative --no-fail-fast && cargo nextest run -p mp --test archive_negative --no-fail-fast && cargo nextest run -p mp --test digest_negative --no-fail-fast.

acceptance_criteria.description: The new tests are not flaky: three consecutive runs of the new/changed tests all pass, and the full mp suite is green.
acceptance_criteria.verification: for i in 1 2 3; do cargo nextest run -p mp --no-fail-fast -E 'binary(autopilot_drive_detach) | binary(breaking_release_apply) | binary(config_cmd_negative) | binary(archive_negative) | binary(digest_negative) | test(/^metrics::|track_archive|^gate_matrix::g6_/)' || exit 1; done && cargo nextest run -p mp --no-fail-fast

work_packages.name: Handler coverage
work_packages.goal: Each thin/zero-coverage handler has direct integration tests (autopilot_detach, breaking_release apply, metrics, archive restore/purge)
work_packages.rollback: Drop the new test files; behavior of the implementations is unchanged

work_packages.name: Gate + error-path coverage
work_packages.goal: G6 and G14 each have direct unit tests; error-path negatives for config/git/archive/digest land

Add crates/mp/tests/suites/metrics.rs and include it from crates/mp/tests/suite_misc.rs (#[path]); cover mp plan metrics set→show round-trip and an unknown-field error.
Add a positive 'mp track archive track-item' integration test (name contains track_archive) to the suite_track binary.
